# Teum

Teum is a dense, monochrome React component and interaction system for product interfaces.

## Documentation routes

- /#introduction - system overview and behavior signature
- /#installation - registry and stylesheet setup
- /#foundations - color, typography, spacing, motion, and Component DNA
- /#button - component documentation begins with Button; the sidebar lists all 45 components
- /#patterns - authored interaction patterns
- /#accessibility - keyboard, focus, motion, contrast, and manual review
- /#browser-support - browser and viewport support policy
- /#security - vulnerability reporting and supported versions
- /#contributing - contribution and review requirements
- /#releases - versioning, evidence, deprecation, and support windows
- /#licensing - MIT permissions and third-party responsibilities

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest registry add @teum=https://interactions.minwookshin.com/r/{name}.json
npx shadcn@latest add @teum/button
```

Installed component source imports the shared contract and its scoped stylesheet. The complete-system item also provides `styles/teum.css` as the application-root base entry. Plain CSS is the source of truth; Tailwind CSS v4 consumers may additionally install `@teum/teum-tailwind` for semantic utilities backed by the same variables.
